reviewSamples.author: Photo of B A
reviewSamples.text: Roza made me feel so comfortable before, during and after my massage appointment. She’s very considerate of preferences including pressure and area of pain. She listens and makes sure that you’re as relaxed as possible. Definitely recommend for pain relief!
